subject: How to show a progress bar while doing parallel processing?

messages.author: a5291522e054e0cd
messages.subject: How to show a progress bar while doing parallel processing?
parts:
Hi,

In my Shiny app, I have a long-running computation and the progress bar works well to indicate user its progress. Now I want to use parallel processing (e.g. doParallel, foreach) to speed up the computation. Is it possible to show the progress bar while doing parallel processing?

Thank you!

Xiaochen
